Class AboutDialog

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.AboutDialog
All Implemented Interfaces:
DialogView<Void>, View
public final class AboutDialog extends Object implements DialogView<Void>
The About dialog of the standard about() command. It shows, from top to bottom, each one that is present: the application's icon, its displayed name, its version and its vendor, then the description, copyright and website of the application class's resources. When the system can browse, the website is a link that opens it through SystemShell; otherwise, it is a read-only, selectable text field without border, so the user can copy it.

Tests answer it with FakeDialogs.answerDialog(AboutDialog.class, ...); only the framework creates it.
